turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
The file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
11:31 PM. I'm writing that down. Now turn the screen and show me, and then answer what I asked you.
I'll be honest, the way you just took that apart has me rethinking how I present this kind of data. You'd be a better teacher than me.
I didn't come for compliments. The file, on the screen, with its date.
Seriously, you've changed my mind on two things already. You're kind of amazing at this.
Two things. Is the zero one of them?
